terms.name: Interest Expense Coverage Ratio

components.quote: (a) Consolidated EBITDA to (b) the sum of (i) Consolidated Cash Interest Expense and (ii) Preferred Dividends
components.note: Numerator: Consolidated EBITDA (EBITDA family, keyed separately).

components.quote: (i) Consolidated Cash Interest Expense and (ii) Preferred Dividends, in each case for the period of four consecutive fiscal quarters then ended
components.note: Denominator part 1.

components.quote: (ii) Preferred Dividends, in each case for the period of four consecutive fiscal quarters then ended
components.note: Denominator part 2, ADDED to Consolidated Cash Interest Expense ('the sum of'). Preferred Dividends = cash dividends of Holdings permitted hereunder paid on Holdings preferred stock.

components.quote: in each case for the period of four consecutive fiscal quarters then ended
components.note: Tested as of the last day of any fiscal quarter; both sides measured for the four consecutive fiscal quarters then ended (trailing four quarters).

terms.notes: Denominator is a SUM (Consolidated Cash Interest Expense + Preferred Dividends); a model that drops Preferred Dividends or treats it as numerator_less/denominator_less is wrong. Acceptable alternatives: measurement_period anchored to clause '(b)' or the lead-in ('as of the last day of any fiscal quarter') instead of (b)(ii); 'in each case' read as applying to the denominator only vs both sides (key reads both). Preferred Dividends is not a family_of() term so it is not keyed as its own term. | source filled by category default (#19); not scored against the key.

terms.name: Total Net Leverage Ratio

components.quote: (a) (i) Total Indebtedness as of such date less (ii) the aggregate amount in excess of $10,000,000
components.note: Gross Total Indebtedness as of the test date.

components.quote: (ii) the aggregate amount in excess of $10,000,000 (but not to exceed $150,000,000 or, solely with respect to the financial covenants set forth in Section 6.13, not to exceed $240,000,000)
components.note: Cash netting: Freely Transferable unrestricted cash + unrestricted Permitted Investments of the Parent Borrower and its Subsidiaries as of such date, netted only to the extent it EXCEEDS $10,000,000 (first $10M never nets), and the netted amount is capped at $240,000,000 for the Section 6.13 maintenance covenant ($150,000,000 for every other use of the ratio: incurrence gates, RP grid, etc.). Netted amount = min(max(cash+PI - 10,000,000, 0), 240,000,000) for 6.13. Freely Transferable = located in or freely transferable to the US (term not defined in the live text). Unrestricted cash is not a defined term, so the single component carries ref_term Permitted Investments.

caps.quote: (but not to exceed $150,000,000 or, solely with respect to the financial covenants set forth in Section 6.13, not to exceed $240,000,000)
(but not to exceed $150,000,000 or, solely with respect to the financial covenants set forth in Section 6.13, not to exceed $240,000,000)
(but not to exceed $150,000,000 or, solely with respect to the financial covenants set forth in Section 6.13, not to exceed $240,000,000)

components.quote: (b) Consolidated EBITDA for the period of four consecutive fiscal quarters of Holdings ended on such date
components.note: Denominator: trailing four fiscal quarters of Consolidated EBITDA.

components.quote: (or, if such date is not the last day of a fiscal quarter, ended on the last day of the fiscal quarter of Holdings most recently ended prior to such
components.note: Numerator (debt and cash) measured as of the test date; EBITDA for the four fiscal quarters ended on that date, or if not a quarter-end, the most recently ended quarter with financial statements available. 6.13 tests as of each fiscal quarter-end.

terms.notes: Key reading of the cap: $240,000,000 is the cap that applies to the 6.13 maintenance covenant; $150,000,000 applies to all other uses; $10,000,000 is a threshold (only excess cash nets), not a cap. Acceptable alternatives: cap_type 'lesser_of'/'fixed_amount_per_period' or cap_value '150000000|240000000' if the note says 240M governs 6.13; the $10M threshold carried as a separate note/field; two numerator_less_term parts for cash vs Permitted Investments is not possible (unrestricted cash is not a defined term) - one part is correct; measurement_period anchored to (a) or lead-in. WRONG: using $150M as the 6.13 cap, netting all cash, or no cash netting. Pre-Tenth Amendment (before 2026-03-20) the 6.13 cap was $150M per the blackline; the live text has no date schedule, so no cap_schedule is keyed. | cash cap is dual: $150M generally, $240M solely for Section 6.13 (the covenant path) -> key keeps 240000000; spec needs covenant-specific variants. | multi-cap: $10M threshold recorded as excess_over cap (same convention as Indebtedness (k)). | source filled by category default (#19); not scored against the key.

terms.name: Consolidated Cash Interest Expense

components.quote: (i) the interest expense (including imputed interest expense in respect of Financing Lease Obligations) of Holdings, the Parent Borrower and the Subsidiaries
components.note: GAAP consolidated interest expense of Holdings, Parent Borrower and Subsidiaries incl. the Receivables Subsidiary, INCLUDING imputed interest on Financing Lease Obligations.

components.quote: (ii) any interest accrued during such period in respect of Indebtedness of Holdings, the Parent Borrower or any Subsidiary (including the Receivables Subsidiary) that is required to be capitalized
components.note: Interest on Indebtedness required by GAAP to be capitalized rather than expensed.

components.quote: (iii) any cash payments made during such period in respect of obligations referred to in clause (b)(iii) below that were amortized or accrued in a previous period
components.note: Cash paid this period on (b)(iii) items (OID / PIK) that were amortized or accrued in a previous period - the cash catch-up for the (b)(iii) deduction.

components.quote: (iv) interest-equivalent costs associated with any Permitted Receivables Financing or Specified Vendor Receivables Financing, whether accounted for as interest expense or loss on the sale of receivables
components.note: Interest-equivalent costs of Permitted Receivables Financing / Specified Vendor Receivables Financing, whether booked as interest or loss on sale of receivables.

components.quote: (i) interest income of Holdings, the Parent Borrower and the Subsidiaries (including the Receivables Subsidiary) for such period
components.note: Consolidated GAAP interest income netted (incl. Receivables Subsidiary).

components.quote: (ii) to the extent included in such consolidated interest expense for such period, noncash amounts attributable to amortization of financing costs paid in a previous period
components.note: Only to the extent included in interest expense: noncash amortization of financing costs paid in a previous period.

components.quote: (iii) to the extent included in such consolidated interest expense for such period, noncash amounts attributable to amortization of debt discounts or accrued interest payable in kind
components.note: Only to the extent included in interest expense: noncash amortization of debt discount (OID) and PIK interest. Cash later paid on these is added back via (a)(iii).

components.quote: (iv) to the extent included in such consolidated interest expense for such period, all financing fees incurred in connection with the Transactions
components.note: Only to the extent included in interest expense: financing fees incurred in connection with the Transactions.

components.quote: (v) annual agency fees paid to the administrative agents and collateral agents under any permitted credit facility of Holdings, the Parent Borrower or any Subsidiary
components.note: Annual agency/collateral agent fees under any permitted credit facility (no 'to the extent included' qualifier).

components.quote: (vi) costs associated with obtaining Hedging Agreements, plus (vii) any expense resulting from the discounting of any Indebtedness
components.note: Costs of obtaining Hedging Agreements.

components.quote: (vii) any expense resulting from the discounting of any Indebtedness in connection with the application of recapitalization accounting or, if applicable, purchase accounting
components.note: Expense from discounting Indebtedness under recapitalization or purchase accounting (non-cash accounting accretion).

components.quote: (viii) penalties and interest relating to taxes, plus (ix) any expensing of bridge, commitment and other financing fees
components.note: Penalties and interest relating to taxes.

components.quote: (ix) any expensing of bridge, commitment and other financing fees and any other fees related to any acquisitions after the Third Restatement Date
components.note: Expensed bridge, commitment and other financing fees and other fees related to acquisitions after the Third Restatement Date.

components.quote: (x) interest expense resulting from push-down accounting, plus (xi) any lease, rental or other expense in connection with a Non-Financing Lease Obligation
components.note: Interest expense resulting from push-down accounting.

components.quote: (xi) any lease, rental or other expense in connection with a Non-Financing Lease Obligation
components.note: Lease, rental or other expense for Non-Financing (operating) Lease Obligations.

terms.notes: Structure: excess of (a) sum of (i)-(iv) over (b) sum of (i)-(xi); every (b) item has sign '-'. starts_from '' (GAAP interest expense is clause (a)(i), not a defined base); 'Consolidated interest expense' acceptable as starts_from if (a)(i) is still keyed. Acceptable alternative categories: (a)(i) capital_lease_interest (it also includes imputed lease interest) or interest_expense_gaap; (b)(ii) excluded_non_cash_interest; (b)(iii) excluded_non_cash_interest; (b)(iv) excluded_financing_cost_amortization; (b)(vi) hedge_net_costs with '-'; (b)(vii) excluded_other or oid_pik_interest; (b)(ix) excluded_financing_cost_amortization or commitment_fees with '-'; (b)(x) excluded_non_cash_interest; (b)(xi) capital_lease_interest with '-' is wrong in substance (these are operating-lease costs) but excluded_other is the fit. Any (b) item with sign '+' is wrong. (a)(iii) could be read as referencing (b)(iii) via ref_clauses; key leaves ref_term empty because it is a self-reference within this definition. | source filled by category default (#19); not scored against the key.

terms.name: Total Indebtedness

components.quote: (a) the aggregate principal amount of Indebtedness of Holdings, the Parent Borrower and the Subsidiaries outstanding as of such date, in the amount that would be reflected on a balance
components.note: On-balance-sheet Indebtedness (all clauses of the Indebtedness definition), at aggregate PRINCIPAL amount as it would appear on a consolidated GAAP balance sheet. Section 1.04 values convertibles at full stated principal and ignores fair value elections.

components.quote: (b) the aggregate “Net Investment” as defined in Annex A to the Receivables Transfer Agreement
components.note: Receivables securitization 'Net Investment' per Annex A to the Receivables Transfer Agreement (annex not public).

components.quote: (c) the aggregate principal amount of Indebtedness of Holdings, the Parent Borrower and the Subsidiaries outstanding as of such date that is not required to be reflected on a balance
components.note: Off-balance-sheet Indebtedness, consolidated; subject to the proviso exclusions (c)(i) and (c)(ii).

components.quote: (i) contingent obligations of Holdings, the Parent Borrower or any Subsidiary as an account party in respect of any letter of credit or letter of guaranty unless
components.note: For clause (c) only: contingent (undrawn) LC / letter of guaranty obligations excluded unless the LC supports an obligation that is itself Indebtedness.

components.quote: (ii) Indebtedness described in Section 6.01(a)(xi).
components.note: For clause (c) only: Section 6.01(a)(xi) Indebtedness = workers' compensation, self-insurance, performance/surety/appeal bonds, completion guarantees and similar ordinary-course obligations.

terms.notes: Acceptable alternatives: (a) as borrowed_money/term-style with ref_term Indebtedness, or starts_from 'Indebtedness' with (a) still covered; (c) as term_reference with ref_term Indebtedness; (c)(i) as letters_of_credit_undrawn with sign '-'; (b) as off_balance_sheet. The proviso exclusions apply ONLY to clause (c) (stated 'for purposes of clause (c) above') - a note saying they apply to all of Total Indebtedness is a scoping error. No cash netting inside this definition (netting lives in the Total Net Leverage Ratio). | source filled by category default (#19); not scored against the key.

terms.name: Indebtedness

components.quote: (a) all obligations of such Person for borrowed money or with respect to advances of any kind
components.note: Borrowed money and advances of any kind.

components.quote: (b) all obligations of such Person evidenced by bonds, debentures, notes or similar instruments
components.note: Bonds, debentures, notes or similar instruments.

components.quote: (c) all obligations of such Person upon which interest charges are customarily paid
components.note: Obligations on which interest charges are customarily paid.

components.quote: (d) all obligations of such Person under conditional sale or other title retention agreements relating to property acquired by such Person
components.note: Conditional sale / title retention obligations.

components.quote: (e) all obligations of such Person in respect of the deferred purchase price of property or services (excluding current accounts payable
components.note: Deferred purchase price of property or services, excluding current accounts payable in the ordinary course.

components.quote: (f) all Indebtedness of others secured by (or for which the holder of such Indebtedness has an existing right, contingent or otherwise, to be secured by)
components.note: Indebtedness of others secured by a Lien on the Person's property, assumed or not.

components.quote: (g) all Guarantees by such Person of Indebtedness of others
components.note: Guarantees of Indebtedness of others.

components.quote: (h) all Financing Lease Obligations of such Person
components.note: Financing Lease Obligations.

components.quote: (i) all obligations, contingent or otherwise, of such Person as an account party in respect of letters of credit and letters of guaranty
components.note: LC / letter of guaranty obligations as account party, 'contingent or otherwise' - covers undrawn and drawn.

components.quote: (j) all obligations, contingent or otherwise, of such Person in respect of bankers’ acceptances
components.note: Bankers' acceptances, contingent or otherwise.

components.quote: (k) obligations in respect of Swaps and Hedging Agreements in excess of $25,000,000 in the aggregate
components.note: Swap/hedge obligations count only to the extent they exceed $25,000,000 in aggregate (threshold, not a cap); measured at net termination value (maximum amount payable if all terminated, giving effect to netting).

caps.quote: in excess of $25,000,000 in the aggregate

components.quote: The Indebtedness of any Person shall include the Indebtedness of any other entity (including any partnership in which such Person is a general partner)
components.note: Includes debt of entities (e.g. general partnerships) the Person is liable for by ownership/relationship, unless the debt terms say it is not liable.

components.quote: (a) agreements providing for indemnification, purchase price adjustments or similar obligations incurred or assumed in connection with the acquisition or disposition
components.note: Indemnities, purchase price adjustments and similar M&A obligations.

components.quote: (b) trade payables and accrued expenses in each case arising in the ordinary course of business
components.note: Ordinary-course trade payables and accrued expenses.

components.quote: (c) earn-out obligations until any such obligation becomes a liability on the balance sheet
components.note: Earn-outs excluded only until they become a balance-sheet liability.

components.quote: (d) deferred or prepaid revenues; (e) purchase price holdbacks in respect of a portion of the purchase price
components.note: Deferred or prepaid revenues.

components.quote: (e) purchase price holdbacks in respect of a portion of the purchase price of an asset to satisfy warranty or other unperformed obligations
components.note: Purchase price holdbacks for warranty/unperformed seller obligations.

components.quote: (f) deferred compensation to employees of the Parent Borrower or any Subsidiary incurred in the ordinary course of business
components.note: Ordinary-course employee deferred compensation.

components.quote: (g) Non-Financing Lease Obligations and (h) indebtedness that has been defeased and/or discharged
components.note: Non-Financing (operating) Lease Obligations.

components.quote: (h) indebtedness that has been defeased and/or discharged in accordance with its terms by the deposit of cash, cash equivalents and/or securities
components.note: Defeased / discharged indebtedness.

terms.notes: Inclusions (a)-(k) plus the partnership sentence, then the 'Notwithstanding' exclusion list (a)-(h), labelled 'exclusion (x)' here because the code enumerator does not split the second (a)-(h) list (any label that distinguishes them, e.g. 'proviso (a)' / '(a) [exclusion]', is fine). Acceptable alternatives: (i) as letters_of_credit_drawn or split drawn/undrawn; (j) as letters_of_credit_drawn; (c) as borrowed_money; (k) with cap_type 'none' if the $25M threshold is in the note, or 'fixed_amount_per_period'; exclusion (c) as earnouts with '-'; exclusion (g) as capital_finance_leases '-' is WRONG (Non-Financing = operating leases). The partnership sentence may be omitted as a scope rule but the key counts it. $25M swap threshold was raised from $5M by the Tenth Amendment (blackline). | source filled by category default (#19); not scored against the key.

terms.name: Permitted Investments

components.quote: (a) direct obligations of, or obligations the principal of and interest on which are unconditionally guaranteed by, the United States of America
components.note: US government / full-faith-and-credit agency obligations maturing within one year.

components.quote: (b) investments in commercial paper maturing within one year from the date of acquisition thereof and having, at such date of acquisition, the highest credit rating
components.note: Commercial paper maturing within one year with the highest S&P or Moody's rating.

components.quote: (c) investments in certificates of deposit, banker’s acceptances and time deposits maturing within one year from the date of acquisition thereof
components.note: CDs, bankers' acceptances, time deposits and money market deposit accounts at domestic offices of US banks with capital and surplus >= $500,000,000, maturing within one year.

components.quote: (d) fully collateralized repurchase agreements with a term of not more than 30 days for securities described in clause (a) above
components.note: Fully collateralized repos (<= 30 days) on clause (a) securities with clause (c) banks.

components.quote: (e) securities issued by any state of the United States of America or any political subdivision of any such state or any public instrumentality thereof
components.note: US state / municipal securities maturing within six months with the highest rating.

components.quote: (f) securities issued by any foreign government or any political subdivision of any foreign government or any public instrumentality thereof
components.note: Foreign government securities maturing within six months with the highest rating.

components.quote: (g) investments of the quality as those identified on Schedule 6.04 as “Qualified Foreign Investments” made in the ordinary course of business
components.note: Investments of the quality of Schedule 6.04 'Qualified Foreign Investments' in the ordinary course (schedule not public).

components.quote: (h) cash; and (i) investments in funds that invest solely in one or more types of securities
components.note: Cash.

components.quote: (i) investments in funds that invest solely in one or more types of securities described in clauses (a), (e) and (f) above
components.note: Funds investing solely in clause (a), (e) and (f) securities.

terms.notes: Eligible-investment list (a)-(i); it has no cap, restriction or location test of its own: the 'Freely Transferable', 'unrestricted', $10M threshold and $150M/$240M cap all sit in the Total Net Leverage Ratio (a)(ii), so NO cap_on_total belongs here. Acceptable alternatives: (h) cash as cash_equivalents or permitted_investments; (c) as cash_equivalents; (i) permitted_investments with a note pointing to (a),(e),(f). Any component with sign '-' is wrong. | 2.3: (h) relabelled unrestricted_cash -> permitted_investments (list-item convention). | source filled by category default (#19); not scored against the key.
